create_config_subclass: create a subclass of BaseConfig to define a kw-only dataclass config with automatic dict coercion
freeze_config: freeze a BaseConfig instance and all subconfigs to prevent further attribute changes
unfreeze_config_temporarily: use the unfreeze context manager to temporarily modify a frozen BaseConfig instance
convert_config_to_dict: call as_dict on a BaseConfig instance to get a nested dictionary representation of the config
use_autocreate_default: use autocreate to mark a BaseConfig field with a default factory derived from its type
